The SEC adopted amendments to Exchange Act Rule 17a-4 on 2022-10-12 (Release No. 34-96034). The effective date was 2023-01-03 and the compliance date 2023-05-03. The amended rule keeps WORM (non-rewriteable, non-erasable) storage as an option and adds an audit-trail alternative that permits the recreation of an original record if it is modified or deleted. FINRA Rule 4511(c) requires books and records made under FINRA rules to be preserved in a format and media that complies with SEA Rule 17a-4.
